name: Future Cleantech Architects
summary: A German think tank working on EU policy for hard-to-decarbonise sectors: heavy industry, high-temperature heat, aviation and shipping fuels, and innovative clean energy technologies.

spending.source: https://www.lobbyregister.bundestag.de/media/b2/cd/817987/2024_Annual_Financial_Statement_Future_Cleantech_Architects_gGmbH.pdf (Future Cleantech Architects gGmbH annual financial statement 2024, profit and loss: staff costs €1,077,833, depreciation €10,551 and other operating expenses €281,352 = €1,369,735; the German accounts do not separate programme from administration, so all of it is counted. Converted at the IRS 2024 yearly average of 1.0823 dollars per euro, facts: fx.usd_per_eur_2024)

lines.label: Policy research and advocacy for clean-technology innovation (EU and international)
lines.source: https://www.lobbyregister.bundestag.de/media/b2/cd/817987/2024_Annual_Financial_Statement_Future_Cleantech_Architects_gGmbH.pdf (same figure; the accounts give no split by programme, so the one line covers both kinds of work as branches of one model: EU and German climate-policy analysis and advice, and the small publicly co-funded research consortia on work and learning in manufacturing firms, AgilOLab and DICoLab, about 3% of spending)
